summary.text: Wes Moore is the incumbent Governor of Maryland, seeking a second term with Lt. Gov. Aruna Miller. A Rhodes Scholar and Army veteran who served in Afghanistan, he led the Robin Hood Foundation before being elected governor in 2022. In office he has signed measures on housing, immigration enforcement, abortion rights and public safety.

paragraphs.text: Graduated from Johns Hopkins University and received a master's degree from Wolfson College, Oxford, as a Rhodes Scholar.
Served in the U.S. Army, including with the 82nd Airborne Division in Afghanistan; later worked as an investment banker.
Served as CEO of the Robin Hood Foundation, a New York anti-poverty organization, before running for governor.
